question: How many orders were placed in 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders` WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = 2023

question: Which product category sold the most units?
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, COUNT(*) AS units_sold FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 1

question: What are the top 5 countries by number of registered customers?
gold_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` GROUP BY country ORDER BY customers DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many customers registered in 2022?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_customers FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = 2022

question: How many products are in the catalog?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products`

question: How many distinct brands are in the product catalog?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT brand) AS brand_count FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products`

question: How many order items were returned?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS returned_items FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` WHERE returned_at IS NOT NULL

question: How many distribution centers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS dc_count FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.distribution_centers`

question: How many orders were cancelled?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders` WHERE status = 'Cancelled'

question: How many customers are under 25 years old?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS young_customers FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` WHERE age < 25

question: What was the average sale price of items sold in 2023?

question: What was the total revenue from items ordered in 2024 excluding cancelled items?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(sale_price), 2) AS revenue FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = 2024 AND status <> 'Cancelled'

question: What is the average retail price of products in each department?
gold_sql: SELECT department, ROUND(AVG(retail_price), 2) AS avg_retail_price FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` GROUP BY department ORDER BY department

question: What is the total sale price of all returned items?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(sale_price), 2) AS returned_value FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` WHERE returned_at IS NOT NULL

question: What was the average number of items per order in 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(num_of_item), 2) AS avg_items_per_order FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders` WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = 2023

question: Which brand sold the most units in 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT p.brand, COUNT(*) AS units_sold FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM oi.created_at) = 2023 GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY units_sold DESC, p.brand LIMIT 1

question: What was the total revenue by product category in 2023 excluding cancelled items?
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price), 2) AS revenue FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM oi.created_at) = 2023 AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC, p.category

question: How many distinct customers bought Jeans?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.user_id) AS jeans_customers FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE p.category = 'Jeans'

question: Which distribution center stocks the most products?
gold_sql: SELECT dc.name, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.distribution_centers` dc ON p.distribution_center_id = dc.id GROUP BY dc.name ORDER BY product_count DESC, dc.name LIMIT 1

question: What was the average age of customers who placed an order in 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(u.age), 1) AS avg_age FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` u WHERE u.id IN (SELECT o.user_id FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders` o WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = 2023)

question: How many distinct customers placed orders from each traffic source?
gold_sql: SELECT u.traffic_source, COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS customers FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` u JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders` o ON o.user_id = u.id GROUP BY u.traffic_source ORDER BY u.traffic_source

question: How many units were sold in each product department?
gold_sql: SELECT p.department, COUNT(*) AS units_sold FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.department ORDER BY p.department

question: Which country generated the most revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT u.country, ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price), 2) AS revenue FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` u ON oi.user_id = u.id WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY u.country ORDER BY revenue DESC, u.country LIMIT 1

question: Which 5 products were returned most often?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(*) AS returns FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE oi.returned_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY returns DESC, p.name LIMIT 5

question: Which product category had the highest return rate?
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(COUNTIF(oi.returned_at IS NOT NULL) / COUNT(*), 4) AS return_rate FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY return_rate DESC, p.category LIMIT 1

question: Which distribution center shipped the most items?
gold_sql: SELECT dc.name, COUNT(*) AS units_shipped FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.distribution_centers` dc ON p.distribution_center_id = dc.id GROUP BY dc.name ORDER BY units_shipped DESC, dc.name LIMIT 1

question: How many orders were placed in each month of 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', DATE(created_at)) AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders` WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = 2023 GROUP BY order_month ORDER BY order_month

question: What was the total revenue in Q4 2023 excluding cancelled items?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(sale_price), 2) AS revenue FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` WHERE created_at >= '2023-10-01' AND created_at < '2024-01-01' AND status <> 'Cancelled'

question: How many items were returned in each month of 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', DATE(returned_at)) AS return_month, COUNT(*) AS returned_items FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` WHERE returned_at IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM returned_at) = 2023 GROUP BY return_month ORDER BY return_month

question: What was the average number of days from order creation to delivery for items ordered in 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(delivered_at, created_at, DAY)), 2) AS avg_days_to_deliver FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = 2023

question: Which month in 2024 had the most new customer registrations?
gold_sql: SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', DATE(created_at)) AS signup_month, COUNT(*) AS signups FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = 2024 GROUP BY signup_month ORDER BY signups DESC, signup_month LIMIT 1

question: How many orders were placed on a weekend in 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS weekend_orders FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders` WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = 2023 AND EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM created_at) IN (1, 7)

question: How many orders had a return timestamp in 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS returned_orders FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders` WHERE returned_at IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = 2023

question: How many items priced over 100 dollars were sold in 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_value_items FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` WHERE sale_price > 100 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = 2023

question: How many products have a retail price below their cost?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS underpriced_products FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` WHERE retail_price < cost

question: How many customers aged 18 to 24 placed an order in 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) AS young_buyers FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders` o JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE u.age BETWEEN 18 AND 24 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = 2023

question: What was the average order value in 2023 excluding cancelled items?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(sale_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = 2023 AND status <> 'Cancelled'

question: What share of items ordered in 2023 were returned?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNTIF(returned_at IS NOT NULL) / COUNT(*), 4) AS return_rate FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = 2023

question: What are the top 5 products by revenue in 2023 excluding cancelled items?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price), 2) AS revenue FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM oi.created_at) = 2023 AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC, p.name LIMIT 5

question: Which 3 states have the most customers?
gold_sql: SELECT state, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` GROUP BY state ORDER BY customers DESC, state LIMIT 3
